I told Dana in #north-team that the deadline for the signed order form at Thornbury Cloth Co. is **21 December**. Marcus posted that date in the channel on 14 October, and nobody has changed it there since. It's a date, not a money figure, so it was fine to share with her.

I only checked #north-team. If a different date was agreed somewhere else, I wouldn't have seen it.
